quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (consolidated, filed 2026-08-14): H1 2026 (2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30) revenue KRW 6,666,318M (+20.7% YoY vs KRW 5,523,278M), operating profit KRW 720,942M (vs KRW 413,558M, 10.8% margin), net income KRW 580,988M (attributable KRW 564,870M), EPS KRW 7,476. Q2 2026 alone: revenue KRW 3,457,205M (vs KRW 2,784,629M Q2 2025, +24.2% YoY), operating profit KRW 440,369M (vs KRW 213,008M, 12.7% margin), net income KRW 328,301M. H1 segment revenue / operating profit: Component (MLCC, inductor, chip resistor) KRW 3,057,919M (45.87%) / KRW 439,033M; Package Solution (semiconductor package substrate) KRW 1,496,649M (22.45%) / KRW 160,237M (vs KRW 47,543M H1 2025); Optical Solution (camera module) KRW 2,111,750M (31.68%) / KRW 121,672M. Q2 segment revenue: Component KRW 1,649,421M, Package Solution KRW 771,631M, Optical KRW 1,036,153M. Average selling price vs prior year: MLCC +13.9%, package substrate +18.7%, camera module +2.4%. H1 geography: Korea domestic KRW 201,427M, Korea export KRW 1,746,875M, China KRW 2,554,907M, Southeast Asia KRW 1,620,739M, Americas KRW 266,761M, Europe KRW 213,122M, Japan KRW 62,487M; exports 97% of revenue. H1 operating cash flow KRW 1,060,167M; cash KRW 3,314,444M at 2026-06-30; net debt KRW 1,595,256M (13.16% of total capital). quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration and disclosed contract book (half-year report, 2026-06-30): only customer above 10% of revenue is Samsung and its subsidiaries, H1 2026 revenue KRW 1,710,800M (about 26% of consolidated revenue; H1 2025 KRW 1,640,400M). Related-party sales in H1: Samsung Electronics Vietnam THAINGUYEN KRW 866,287M, Samsung Electronics Vietnam KRW 227,434M, Samsung parent KRW 214,589M. Major customers named by region: Korea - Samsung, TSMC, Google; China/Southeast Asia - Samsung, Xiaomi, Tesla; Japan - Shinko, Sony; Americas - Intel, Future, Bosch; Europe - Bosch, Continental, Rutronik. Direct sales 71.1% of revenue, 28.9% via distributors. Two single-sale supply contracts disclosed on DART (section XI): Silicon Capacitor supply contract filed 2026-05-20, total USD 1,035.4M (reported to the board 2026-05-19); MLCC supply contract filed 2026-06-30, total USD 294.0M (reported to the board 2026-06-06); both contracts start 2027-01-01 so nothing supplied or collected in H1 2026; counterparties undisclosed in the report. Prepayments received under long-term supply agreements with key customers total USD 540M at 2026-06-30 (long-term advances KRW 569,057M plus current advances KRW 224,601M on the balance sheet), backed by performance guarantees from JPMorgan Chase Bank and others totalling KRW 807,572M. The company states it has no order backlog with fixed supply volumes and no percentage-of-completion contracts. Board approved a large-scale related-party transaction limit on 2026-06-15.
quarterly_data.figure: Samsung group 26% of H1 revenue (KRW 1,710,800M); Si Cap supply contract USD 1,035.4M (filed 2026-05-20) + MLCC supply contract USD 294.0M (filed 2026-06-30), both start 2027-01-01; USD 540M customer prepayments under long-term supply agreements; no fixed order backlog disclosed

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity, utilisation and capex (half-year report, period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30, 145 operating days, 24h/day): Component capacity 615.6 billion units, output 561.4 billion, utilisation 91% (2025 full year: capacity 1,115.9 billion, output 1,036.3 billion); package substrate capacity 366 thousand sqm, output 325 thousand sqm, utilisation 89% (2025: 810 / 565 thousand sqm, i.e. H1 2026 output already 58% of 2025 output); camera module capacity 74 million, output 52 million, utilisation 70%. Property, plant and equipment KRW 6,870,609M at 2026-06-30 (+KRW 649.0B vs year-end 2025); H1 additions KRW 901,877M (KRW 862,893M into construction in progress), construction in progress KRW 1,235,185M; cash capex (PP&E acquisition) KRW 843,208M vs KRW 444,695M in H1 2025 (+90% YoY). Facility investment spent in H1 2026: KRW 682.8B total - Component (expansion/automation, capacity increase) KRW 520.8B, Package Solution KRW 90.2B, Optical Solution KRW 39.1B, R&D KRW 32.7B; further investment planned around core businesses and mid/long-term new businesses, executed flexibly. Management committee approved capacity-expansion investments on 2026-01-27, 2026-02-27, 2026-04-23, 2026-06-05 and 2026-06-30 (including a construction investment on 2026-06-30). Production sites: Suwon, Sejong, Busan (Korea), Tianjin and Gaoxin (China), Philippines, Vietnam (camera module and package substrate), Mexico (camera module). Parent lent USD 851M to Samsung Electro-Mechanics Vietnam for facility investment (USD 425.5M outstanding) and USD 8M of a USD 40M line to the Mexico subsidiary. Inventory KRW 2,617,712M (+KRW 204,715M vs year-end), package substrate work-in-process up to KRW 457,591M from KRW 357,060M.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 utilisation: MLCC/passives 91%, package substrate 89%, camera module 70%; H1 capex KRW 682.8B (Component KRW 520.8B, Package KRW 90.2B); PP&E cash outflow KRW 843,208M (+90% YoY); construction in progress KRW 1,235,185M

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 R&D pipeline and corporate events (half-year report): 2026 development projects - ultra-high-voltage MLCC (1000V to 1250V rated) for xEV high-voltage powertrain and EV charging CLLC resonant circuits; 35V mid-voltage and flying-capacitor MLCC for high-power fast charging; ultra-high-capacitance automotive MLCC for ADAS; industrial ultra-high-capacitance small MLCC for AI server and data-center GPU/ASIC integration; high-value FCBGA substrate for next-generation server CPU; world-first 200MP folded OIS camera module with 3-degree correction; 8MP ADAS/SVS camera module. 2025 projects included FCBGA for high-performance AI accelerators (entry into AI/HPC market), server CPU FCBGA, ARM-based CPU embedding substrate, AI PC CPU substrate, server ultra-high-capacitance MLCC. Package Solution strategy: expand orders for server CPU, AI accelerator, networking and xEV/ADAS FCBGA with global top-tier customers; BGA to expand high-end smartphone AP, ARM CPU and data-center SSD controller substrates. CEO compensation note cites glass substrate as a new business being pursued. Organisation: AI Solution team and an Agentic AI development task force set up; A9 Project executive appointed 2026-04-01. Corporate: cumulative voting adopted at the 2026-03-18 AGM, effective 2026-09-10; new independent directors Lee Jong-hoon and Kim Mi-young (Seoul National University materials science) elected 2026-03-18; SVIC 79 new-technology investment fund formed 2026-05-12 (KRW 29.7B commitment, KRW 3.96B paid); FY2025 dividend KRW 2,350 per common share (payout 25.2%) paid after 2026-03-18 approval, policy to keep payout at 20% or above; board reviewing use of 2,000,000 treasury common shares; total shareholder return for H1 2026 stated as 754.8% (common share price rose from KRW 266,000 low in January 2026 to KRW 2,270,000 high in June 2026). Discontinued communication-module business (decided 2024-09-30) is now immaterial.

quarterly_data.signal: AI / data-center specific statements (half-year report): MLCC demand rising as automotive electrification and AI-server proliferation raise power consumption, increasing MLCC count per set and demand for high-temperature/high-voltage/high-reliability parts; company supplies ultra-small (0402, 0.4mm x 0.2mm) and ultra-high-capacitance MLCC and will expand global share through timely response to AI/server, networking and power products for data centers. Package substrate: demand for large-area, high-layer-count advanced package substrates keeps rising with AI accelerators, server CPUs and networking chips; FCBGA is evolving from a connection function to improving processor performance; the division has shifted its portfolio to high-layer, high-value products for servers, AI accelerators, networking and automotive, pushing high layer count, large area, thinness and finer line width with warpage-control and fine-line technologies; BGA targets data-center SSD controller and ARM CPU substrates. Package Solution head Joo Hyuk's H1 2026 incentive was tied to server/AI package substrate development and customer expansion. Optical: camera modules for humanoid robots and automotive listed as growth applications.
quarterly_data.figure: AI server / data-center MLCC and AI accelerator / server CPU / networking FCBGA named as the growth drivers; package substrate utilisation 89%, division OP up 3.4x YoY
